newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gen des Eaux gains on profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Gen des Eaux gains on profit forecast.

text.p: Shares in Generale des Eaux were up nearly two percent in late trading in the Paris bourse on chairman Jean-Marie Messier's forecast in a French newspaper interview for a "modest" profit for 1996, brokers said.
"It seems a little better than expected," said a broker.

Analysts' earnings forecasts for the group range from 1.5 billion francs to 2.6 billion for 1996 after a 3.7 billion franc loss last year. They expect a jump in profit next year to between 2.8 billion and 3.5 billion francs.
"I can confirm a return to profit this year of a modest level, including exceptional items," Messier told Le Figaro.
"For the following years, from 1997, our results should be more representative of the group's potential," he added.

Generale des Eaux shares were 1.89 percent higher at 540 francs at 1445 GMT. They were not affected by a first-half loss reported by Eiffage, a public works company in which Generale des Eaux holds a 33 percent stake.
